thread:
frank: quick note 1: found a stale observability playground snippet and a dead internal link. will open a small PR.

linkchecker-bot: link scan: /console/playground/kv-patterns -> 404.

frank: snippet on page still uses deprecated `client.prefetch()`; needs to be updated to `client.kv_get_many()` which returns a list with per-item latency. current:```
# python
client.prefetch('user_123', max_prefix=256)
```
proposed:```
# python
items = client.kv_get_many('user_123', max_items=5)
# items -> [{"key":"u_1", "value":"...", "latency_ms":4}]
```

maya: good catch. add a one-line compat shim for the cost example that expects a dict:```
lat_map = {it['key']: it['latency_ms'] for it in items}
cost_ms = sum(lat_map.values())
```

rae: also add frontmatter redirect for the missing page so external links don't 404:```
---
redirect_from:
  - /console/playground/kv-patterns
---
```

docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5421 title: "playground: migrate prefetch -> kv_get_many, add compat shim and redirect". CI: link-check queued.

sam: will review once CI passes. suggest adding a tiny trace PNG showing `key` and `latency_ms` in span attrs for QA.

frank: thanks all 1: I'll attach screenshot and changelog note in the PR, then assign reviewers.
